subject: prd/impl-review
statement: `review_artifact_publication_terminal` fires when one completed-report publication attempt reaches a verified or failed terminal
intent: `review_process_id:string`, `review_obligation_id:string`, `publication_attempt_id:string`, `proposal_id:string`, `reviewed_revision:string`, `medium:enum{github,carina}`, `idempotency_id:string`, `status:enum{verified,failed}`, `artifact_ref:string?`, `native_receipt:string?`, `attempt_proof_ref:string?`, `failure_class:enum{artifact_unverified,artifact_untrusted,infrastructure}?`, `reason:string?`; `verified` requires `artifact_ref`, `native_receipt`, and `attempt_proof_ref` and forbids failure fields; `failed` requires failure fields and forbids artifact acceptance; for a reciprocal host terminal emitted for the same publication moment, `review_process_id`, `review_obligation_id`, `proposal_id`, `reviewed_revision`, `artifact_ref`, `native_receipt`, and `attempt_proof_ref` pair respectively with `review_attempt_id`, `review_obligation_id`, `proposal_ref`, `revision`, `artifact_ref`, `native_receipt`, and `attempt_proof_ref`; the first four pairs are required, optional pairs have identical presence, and every present pair carries the same grammar and value; `publication_attempt_id` is distinct and has no host alias; a host terminal is eligible only when its own approved contract declares this reciprocal schema
